articles.title: WoW: Forever Hotfixes - November 10, 2026
warlock_changes: Fixed a bug causing the Succubus whip sound to play much too often.
Imp base damage of the first 4 Ranks of Imp's Firebolt increased, and base Imp Health increased by ~15%.

Affliction: Soul Siphon now grants increased effect to Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack by 4/8/12% per Corruption, Siphon Life, and Bane of Agony active on the target, up to 36% (was any Affliction spell).
Affliction: Wrack no longer increases the damage of the Warlock's periodic effects on the target.
Affliction: While channeling Wrack, Siphon Life, Corruption, and Bane of Agony deal periodic damage 100% faster.
Destruction: Bane of Havoc now correctly incurs a global cooldown.
Completing Summon Felsteed now grants the appropriate riding skill.
Incinerate is no longer available to non-Destruction specializations.
Voidwalker base Health increased by about 40 at all levels.
Soul Siphon no longer incorrectly causes Wrack to increase its own damage.
Orc Command no longer causes some Warlock pet abilities to benefit too much.
